notes: PROVISIONAL defaults pending a calibration pilot (docs/regime.md).
No model default: the runner refuses to launch without --model.
instances null = all four scenarios (solvara-market-access, meridian-soc2, castellan-software, bluestem-demand).
reps 4 = the paper's n=4 design (4 arms x 4 scenarios x 4 reps = 64 cells per model).
max_turns 80: the paper set no turn limit; 80 is set generously so that it is not the binding constraint.
wall_clock_s 3600 and usd_rail 8.0 match the paper's per-trial DIFFLAB_TIMEOUT default and --max-budget-usd 8. Both are rails: a trial that hits one is scored, never retried.
Every arm needs bash (min_isolation CONTAINER); host-unsafe runs are recorded as non-conforming.
judge_model is only used by the optional ELO pass (dbwm eval5-elo); claude-sonnet-4-6 is the paper's grader.
